equity.description: Current megavault equity (TVL) in USDC, computed live from positions.

allTimePnl.description: Cumulative megavault PnL in USDC since `VAULT_PNL_START_DATE`.

apr.description:
30-day annualized return as a decimal fraction (e.g. "0.15" = 15% APR), or null
if there is not enough PnL history to compute it.

maxDrawdown.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline of cumulative PnL in USDC over the PnL history window.

volume24H.description: Total notional volume traded by vault subaccounts over the past 24 hours in USDC.

createdAt.description: Time of the first transfer into the megavault, or null if there are no transfers yet.
